svg.text: E Sub-mechanisms (1) — washing without a dishwasher
Each panel loops on its own. Cleaning-first tricks usable in any concept.
source: E-cleaning-first.md section 6
S1 drip collar: see E-alles-geschirr; S5 jet gate: see E-spuelzelle
S2 Wash holster: the tool becomes a pipe

g.text: with a 3 mm gap all round

svg.text: 1 L loop: turbidity of the rinse is very sensitive.
Feasibility H (simple tools), M (whisks)
S14 Spin-rinse-dry for round ware

g.text: dry in ~20 s, no hot air

svg.text: Bowl upside down on a spindle over one nozzle line; 1–2 L.
Same spindle = salad spinner. Feasibility H
S20 Steam gate for the knife
Melts fat, sanitises; removes most mid-meal knife washes.
Not for dried soil. Feasibility H
S7 Flash pyrolysis by induction
Grids, plates, needles: 300 g needs 65 kJ, < 1 min (wash: 1.3 kWh).
Not knives (they soften); ferritic steel only; smoke needs a catalyst.
Feasibility M as weekly reset
S8 Bread pig

g.text: tube / grinder wall with mince film

svg.text: Bread wipes wall and blades, soaks up the residue and is
used in the mass anyway. Feasibility H (if the recipe has bread)
S18 Flume transfer

g.text: closed pipe = its own CIP line

svg.text: Cut vegetables ride a water stream into the pot basket.
Seconds of contact; not for anything that must stay dry. Feas. M
